issue: The optional WebGPU queue completion diagnostic rejected on this headless adapter.
fix: Render diagnostics inspect state without awaiting the unsupported queue completion call.

issue: A title-screen explorer stood outside the visible mesa.
fix: Moved the explorer onto the mesa.

issue: Cloned cloth node materials lost the intended awning colors.
fix: Constructed cloth materials with explicit color and gradient.

issue: On a slow load the attract timer could expire before the title was ready for touch input.
fix: Start the idle timer after shader compilation, and count all pointer presses as activity; refine the compact landscape layout.

issue: A newly joined co-op player could lack a visible actor when the roster changed within the same room.
fix: Rebuild client scene state when the roster or authoritative scene serial changes; do not transmit pre-launch room state.

issue: The automated driver could stop while an evade animation was still moving the explorer, then miss a seal interaction.
fix: Wait for the evade to finish before reporting arrival; assert that every scripted interaction succeeds and use consistent keyboard input.

issue: The original attract route could repeatedly visit an empty tomb instead of showing the entire expedition.
fix: Use a fixed Scarab replay route, retain the first waypoint after stage transitions, demonstrate all three swings, and validate two loops using only attract-run events.

issue: The canyon foreground wall obscured the landing ledge.
fix: Use a cutaway foreground wall and make world inscriptions larger and independent of depth occlusion.

issue: Long notebook and About screens needed controller scrolling.
fix: Right-stick scrolling and Page Up / Page Down with prompts; touch scrolling enabled for the panel body.

issue: World inscriptions did not survive scene transitions because the renderer lost the shared Sprite geometry.
fix: Do not dispose Three.js shared Sprite geometry when unloading a room; verify the inscriptions in a fresh renderer.
